next.reason: 1985 GR1: the file 'must be open in the input or I-O mode at the time that the START statement is executed'. 2023 §2023:14.9.41.4 GR1: 'The open mode of the file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall be input or I-O'; Table 20 of §2023:14.9.27.4 GR8 restates it (START: Input and I-O only), and §2023:9.1.13.7 GR7 defines status 47 for 'a READ or START statement ... not open in the input or I-O mode', the same status 1985 already defined (Indexed I-O status 47). A run-time requirement in both; no compile-time refusal became an exception. Same meaning for a conforming 1985 program.
